title: annovar-nf parameters
description: Scalable, reproducible ANNOVAR annotation of VCF/BCF files (hg19 / hg38) with Nextflow

input.description: A VCF/BCF file, a directory of them, a glob, or a samplesheet (.csv/.tsv: id, vcf[, index][, genome]).
input.help_text: Accepted: .vcf, .vcf.gz (BGZF or plain gzip), .vcf.bgz, .gvcf.gz, .bcf; indexed or not; sorted or not; single- or multi-sample. Required with --mode annotate.

input_pattern.description: File pattern used when --input is a directory.

recursive.description: Also search sub-directories of an --input directory.

publish_dir_mode.description: How result files are written to --outdir.

genome.description: Genome build of the input: auto detects it per file from ##contig lengths, header hints and the file name.

skip_build_check.description: Use the given --genome even when the file says otherwise (not recommended).

annovar_src.description: Directory containing table_annovar.pl (ANNOVAR is licensed separately and not bundled).

protocol.description: Comma-separated ANNOVAR protocol overriding the per-build defaults (conf/annovar_protocols.config).

operation.description: Operations matching --protocol (g,f,r,gx); inferred from --protocol when omitted.

annovar_protocols.description: Per-build default protocols as ['database:operation', ...] lists (set in a config file).

threads.description: CPUs for ANNOVAR per input file: the file is split into one chunk per CPU, each annotated by its own ANNOVAR process.

skip_db_check.description: Do not verify before annotation that every database file exists.

auto_install_db.description: Install the protocol databases that are not installed yet before annotating: ANNOVAR packages (verified, atomic) and ClinVar from NCBI. Installed databases are left as they are.

mode.description: annotate, check_db (read-only audit of every protocol database) or update_db (install missing or damaged databases, build the newest ClinVar).

db_builds.description: Builds to check or update, comma-separated (default: every build with a protocol).

clinvar_release.description: ClinVar release built for 'clinvar_latest': latest or YYYYMMDD.

db_offline.description: Audit databases without contacting ANNOVAR or NCBI.

chunk_size.description: At most about this many records per chunk; 0 never splits a file.

drop_genotypes.description: Annotate sites only (drop FORMAT and sample columns).

min_ac.description: Drop alleles with AC below this after splitting multi-allelic sites (0 keeps all).

fasta_hg19.description: hg19 reference FASTA (with .fai): enables left-alignment of indels.

fasta_hg38.description: hg38 reference FASTA (with .fai): enables left-alignment of indels.

check_ref.description: bcftools norm --check-ref when a FASTA is given: e (error), w (warn), x (exclude), s (set).

ped.description: PED file (or its CSV/TSV export) with families, sex and affected status: inheritance analysis and sex/relatedness checks.

skip_sample_qc.description: Skip the per-sample QC (sex check, relatedness).

family_max_samples.description: Files with at most this many samples get the family analysis and one report column per sample.

gene_info.description: Show the diseases and modes of inheritance of every gene (GenCC) and its loss-of-function constraint (gnomAD LOEUF) in the report; the gene table is built in humandb on the first run (--auto_install_db) and refreshed by --mode update_db.

gene_panel.description: Gene panel(s), comma-separated: text files with one gene symbol per line, or PanelApp TSV exports (green genes). The report shows variants in other genes only on request.

qc_min_dp.description: Genotype flag LOW_DP below this read depth.

qc_min_gq.description: Genotype flag LOW_GQ below this genotype quality.

qc_min_alt_reads.description: Genotype flag LOW_ALT_READS: carriers with fewer reads supporting the alt allele.

qc_het_vaf.description: Genotype flag VAF_SKEW: heterozygous alt-allele fraction outside MIN,MAX.

qc_min_hom_vaf.description: Genotype flag VAF_SKEW: homozygous or hemizygous alt-allele fraction below this.

save_normalized.description: Also publish the normalized per-chunk VCFs.

resource_options.title: Resource limits
resource_options.description: Ceilings for any single task; with the local executor also the capacity it schedules into. Default: the machine Nextflow runs on.

max_cpus.description: Maximum CPUs (--threads above it is capped).

container.description: Runtime image for -profile docker / singularity / apptainer (ANNOVAR is mounted, not bundled).

help.description: Show the help message and exit.

monochrome_logs.description: Plain, uncoloured log messages (e.g. when logging to a file).

trace_report_suffix.description: Suffix of the execution report, timeline and trace file names (default: the start time).
